findings.current: “A man whose eyes are smaller than his asshole, and you’re deaf to boot. Have you already forgotten that I said you were both wrong?”
findings.defect: The draft changes both the speaker of the earlier statement and its targets. The goateed man—not Spatula Chin—said that Spatula Chin and Bird Eyes were both wrong.
findings.rationale: The Korean refers back to the goateed man’s preceding statement, “둘 다 틀렸네,” and Spatula Chin is one of the two people it described.
findings.replacement: “You bastard, your eyes are smaller than your asshole, and now you’re deaf too. Have you already forgotten that he said both of us were wrong?”
findings.source: “눈깔은 똥구멍보다 작은놈이 귀까지 먹었군. 앞서 둘 다 틀렸다고 한 말은 벌써 잊어버렸나?”

findings.current: The white-haired old man who had spent his days sitting beside a secluded lake left without a word, a spear strapped to his back in place of his fishing rod.
findings.defect: “Left without a word” contradicts the farewell he has just spoken and does not convey 홀연히, which describes his abrupt departure.
findings.rationale: 홀연히 means suddenly or abruptly, not silently; the distinction preserves the old master’s decisive response to the news.
findings.replacement: The white-haired old man who had spent his days sitting beside a secluded lake abruptly departed, a spear strapped to his back in place of his fishing rod.
findings.source: 인적 드문 호숫가에 앉아 시간을 보내던 백발의 노인은 낚싯대 대신 창을 등에 멘 채 홀연히 떠났다.

findings.current: “They’ve created something called the Murim Alliance in Henan, and they’re going to fight Dark Heaven—the successor to that Demonic Cult.
findings.defect: The draft presents Dark Heaven’s status as the Demonic Cult’s successor as an unqualified fact, dropping the reported-information framing of 이라는 and the sentence-final 다고 합니다.
findings.rationale: The villager is relaying news rather than asserting firsthand knowledge, so the source’s hearsay register should remain explicit.
findings.replacement: “They say something called the Murim Alliance has been formed in Henan, and that it’s going to fight Dark Heaven, which is said to be the successor to that Demonic Cult.
findings.source: 하남에서 무림맹이라는 것이 만들어졌고, 바로 그 마교의 후신이라는 암천과 일전을 겨룬다고 합니다.

findings.current: “Brother, it seems our paths overlap. Let us travel together.”
findings.defect: The draft omits 방금 말씀하신, the cue that the stranger is responding specifically to what the other man just said.
findings.rationale: The omitted phrase establishes how the unaffiliated strangers recognize their shared destination and begin traveling together.
findings.replacement: “Brother, from what you just said, it seems we’re headed the same way. Let us travel together.”
findings.source: “방금 말씀하신 형장. 나와 가는 길이 겹치는 것 같은데, 함께 갑시다.”

findings.current: In the new era they had opened themselves, they would fight against a new enemy.
findings.defect: “Opened themselves” misattaches the reflexive pronoun and reads as though the people opened themselves rather than personally ushering in the era.
findings.rationale: 스스로 modifies their act of opening the new era; “ushered in” preserves that agency in natural English.
findings.replacement: In the new era they themselves had ushered in, they would fight a new enemy.
findings.source: 그들이 스스로 연 새로운 시대에서 새로운 적과 맞서 싸울 테다.

findings.current: “That they’re all hothouse flowers. How much can people who grew up eating and sleeping in comfortable surroundings really accomplish on a battlefield?”
findings.defect: “Grew up eating and sleeping in comfortable surroundings” is an unnatural literal calque of 먹고 자란 and weakens the dismissive spoken delivery.
findings.rationale: 좋은 환경에서 먹고 자란 means they were comfortably or well raised, not that their eating and sleeping are separate points.
findings.replacement: “They’re all hothouse flowers. How much can people raised in comfort really accomplish on a battlefield?”
findings.source: “죄다 온실 속 화초들이라 이거지. 좋은 환경에서 먹고 자란 것들이 전장에서 얼마나 큰 활약을 보일 수 있겠나?”

findings.current: Some would fall in an unknown wasteland and never rise again. Others would carve their names into a chapter of the long history of Murim.
findings.defect: “Wasteland” adds barrenness absent from 벌판, which denotes an open field or plain.
findings.rationale: The source specifies an unnamed open plain, not desolate or unusable land.
findings.replacement: Some would fall on an unknown plain and never rise again. Others would carve their names into a chapter of the long history of Murim.
findings.source: 누군가는 이름 모를 벌판에 쓰러져 영영 일어나지 못할 것이고, 누군가는 자신의 이름을 이 기나긴 무림사 한 편에 새겨넣으리라.

summary: One critical speaker-attribution error, two meaningful fidelity issues, and several localized wording defects.
